verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability for viewing observability spend or usage, attributing it to teams or services, or alerting on usage spikes before billing. The cost mentions do not cover this story: predictable storage with time series data streams, tiered storage, LLM app cost tracking, and profiling to cut cloud spend are adjacent features, not visibility into observability spend.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can see what my observability spend is, attribute it to teams or services, and catch usage spikes before the bill
